explanation: Recursively concatenate the left and right subtrees’ leaf-node lists. The supplied wrapper extracts their values in left-to-right order. Concatenation copies lists at ancestors.
timeComplexity: O(nh) conservative bound for n nodes and height h
spaceComplexity: O(n+h) pending leaf-list/recursion storage, including output
